pride_data.title: TYROSINE MODIFICATION ANALYSIS OF FUSION GLYCOPROTEIN FROM HUMAN RESPIRATORY SYNCYTIAL VIRUS A2
pride_data.projectDescription: Map the location of the dityrosine bond in the purified crosslinked sample(DT-preF) by LC-ESI-MS/MS.The uncrosslinked protein (preFC) was used for comparison.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: The sample were denatured in 8M urea, treated with DTT to reduce disulfide bonds, and then reacted with iodoacetamide to alkylate Cysteine residues. The samples were cleaned up by washing with solvent to remove all chemicals. The sample was digested for LC/MS/MS sequencing with the following digestive enzymes: trypsin, chymotrypsin and pepsin. The solution digestion procedure followed ProtTech’s SOP: Solution Protein Digestion Protocol.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: These data were generated under contract with ProtTech Inc. Phoenixville, PA. Peaks were manually assigned using in-house proprietary software.
